title: Simple prefix BSGS with conservative implemented local-link storage

claims.statement: For the full protected fixed-G1 pairing inversion target, the deterministic prefix algorithm in proof.md succeeds with probability exactly2^254/r>1/2, using total cold classical computation at most2^138 dense-Fp12 reference equivalents at fixed C=20000. All processors,failed queries,transfers,initialization,preprocessing,pairings,output and verification are charged; all loads/stores use bounded local64-bit addresses and explicit neighbor packets. Peak total storage is below2^145 bytes,preprocessing below2^138 equivalents is included,and advice is zero. This is an analytical bound,not production execution.
